algebraic_identity.valid: Phi tensor u_- - Phi tensor u_+ = tau(z)(Phi tensor exp(zq))
algebraic_identity.scope: an algebraic/exponential-distribution history module large enough to contain exp(zq)
algebraic_identity.not_yet: the rapid projective pair carrier on which T_pair_to_border and its entire Laplace jets were constructed

domain_obstruction.failure: h_z is not a rapidly decaying theta/history vector on the full line or positive tail
domain_obstruction.tensor: Phi tensor h_z therefore need not belong to the declared rapid projective pair module
domain_obstruction.consequence: Xi-divisibility before applying the bordered functor does not imply Xi-divisibility after it unless the functor extends continuously to this exponential homotopy leg

explicit_shell_pole.two_parameters: use z for the Evans history and zeta for the bordered Laplace readout
explicit_shell_pole.Laplace: R_(Phi,h_z)(zeta)=A_[a,b](z)/(zeta-z) for Re(zeta-z)>0, followed by meromorphic continuation
explicit_shell_pole.diagonal: at zeta=z the defining integral is A_[a,b](z) integral_0^infinity 1 dt and diverges
explicit_shell_pole.generic_nonzero: A_[a,b](z) is not identically zero for a nonzero theta forcing and a nonempty shell

effect_on_mod_tau.formal_difference: T_border(Delta_-)-T_border(Delta_+)=tau(z) A_[a,b](z)/(zeta-z) in the off-diagonal two-parameter region
effect_on_mod_tau.problem: restriction to the physical diagonal zeta=z is not a holomorphic tau multiple; it has an unresolved diagonal pole
effect_on_mod_tau.multiplicity: pointwise equality at tau(z0)=0 survives for the zero-order glued history, but a holomorphic mapping-cone lift preserving all divisor jets does not follow

legal_repairs: retain z and zeta as independent parameters, construct the two-variable mapping cone, and prove a source-prescribed diagonal finite-part/residue cancellation
modify the homotopy by a cutoff/relative-tail subtraction that lies in the bordered graph domain while preserving its boundary tau
define the pair-to-border operation on an exponential rigging with a renormalized Laplace transform and verify Stokes, C4, and positivity there
noncircularity_rule: The diagonal pole subtraction must be fixed by the Green/Stokes source convention before Xi specialization; multiplying by tau and declaring the value zero at its zeros is not a holomorphic extension when the quotient still has 1/(zeta-z).
next_test: Compare the existing bivariate moving-seam response with the meromorphic kernel tau(z)A_[a,b](z)/(zeta-z). Determine whether its (1+partial_c) Stokes boundary supplies exactly the required diagonal finite part without erasing the independent Xi channel.
conclusion: Fixing Phi in one tensor leg gives the correct algebraic variance and a formal Xi-divisible difference, but the explicit homotopy coefficient is an exponential generalized mode outside the rapid bordered domain. Its Laplace image has a pole on the physical parameter diagonal. The relative Evans-to-pair lift therefore remains open at a precise two-parameter renormalized-domain gate.
